note: What scripts/endpoint-roles/extract-calls.mjs cannot see by itself, for the endpoint-role guard (scripts/endpoint-roles.test.mjs). unresolved: a site whose address the extractor cannot follow (file and the address expression as written), with the calls it makes (verb, path with {} for an unknown part, params) or none and why. ticketRoles: a ticketed call whose ticket is asked in another file, with the roles asked (null = a ticket with no role). notCalls: a member the extractor reports as a call of its own that nothing calls. An entry that matches nothing fails the guard.

unresolved.reason: The WMS tile loader: src is the tile address OpenLayers builds from the layer's url, the /wms proxy servlet, which is outside the handler mapping (WmsProxyServletTest, WmsProxyServletITTest, WmsProxyHttpITTest).
The application's own index.html, read to compare build versions; not the backend.
An input: each page binds its API service's uploadUrl(), which the extractor reports as a POST of its own (member <Service>.uploadUrl).
An input: the attachments and the layout fields bind their uploadUrl, which the extractor reports as a POST of its own (member AttachmentsField.uploadUrl, LayoutField.uploadUrl).

download(url, …) fetches the PDF its callers build with buildListUrl (the list, the selection and the report editor's test print) or buildSingleMessageUrl (one message), each with the print dialog's settings and its one-time ticket; the report's own parameters (param:…) and the list's filter are added as they come.
